description: This file is the main entry point for a FastAPI-based backend API for a career platform. It sets up the application, middleware, database initialization, seed data, health check endpoints, CRUD endpoints for templates and roles, and includes various routers for different API modules.

classes.name: FastAPI
classes.description: The main application object initialized with API metadata and middleware.

methods.name: None on_startup()
methods.description: Creates database tables and seeds initial data based on environment variables when the application starts.

methods.name: dict health_check()
methods.description: Basic health check endpoint indicating if the service is running.

methods.name: TemplateOut create_template(payload: TemplateCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Creates a new template record in the database.

methods.name: List[TemplateOut] list_templates(db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Retrieves all templates from the database.

methods.name: TemplateOut get_template(template_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Retrieves a specific template by ID.

methods.name: TemplateOut update_template( template_id: int, payload: TemplateUpdate, db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Updates fields of an existing template.

methods.name: None delete_template(template_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
List[RoleRead] list_roles(db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Retrieves all roles from the database.

methods.name: RoleRead create_role(payload: RoleCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
RoleRead get_role(role_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
